description.summary: exact rounded shapes for background effects

protocol.description:
A compositor that draws a background effect (blur, frosted or refracting glass) behind a surface needs the outline of the area the effect covers. wl_region can only describe a union of integer rectangles, so a rounded card becomes a staircase, and a compositor that derives the outline from the buffer's alpha has to reconstruct a shape the client already knows exactly.
This protocol lets a client describe that area as a set of rounded rectangles in surface-local logical coordinates with sub-pixel precision and a radius per corner. Which effect the compositor draws, and whether it draws one at all, is compositor policy and outside this protocol.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: wlrfx_background_effect_shape_manager_v1
interface.description: A global to attach a shape object to a wl_surface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Existing shape objects are not affected.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a shape object

request.name: get_shape

description.summary: get the shape object of a surface

request.description: Create a shape object for the surface. If the surface already has a shape object, the already_constructed protocol error is raised.

interface.name: wlrfx_background_effect_shape_v1

description.summary: the effect area of one surface

interface.description: The shape state is double-buffered and applied on the next wl_surface.commit, together with the buffer and the other state of that commit. The initial state is "unset": the compositor determines the effect area by its own means, which is also the state after this object is destroyed (applied on the next commit).

entry.name: invalid_shapes
entry.summary: the array is malformed or a value is out of range

entry.name: surface_destroyed
entry.summary: the wl_surface was destroyed before this object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the object. On the next commit of the surface the shape state returns to "unset".

request.name: set_shapes
request.description:
Set the effect area to the union of the given rounded rectangles.
The array holds 8 wl_fixed_t values per rectangle, in this order: x, y, width, height, radius_top_left, radius_top_right, radius_bottom_right, radius_bottom_left. Coordinates are surface-local and logical. width and height must be greater than zero and every radius must be zero or greater; otherwise the invalid_shapes error is raised, as it is when the array length is not a multiple of 8 values. A radius larger than half the shorter side is clamped to it.
At most 16 rectangles are allowed; more raise too_many_shapes. The rectangles should not overlap; where they do, the compositor may treat each pixel as belonging to any one of them.
An empty array sets an empty effect area: the surface has no background effect for this commit.
